- enum class `SeekMode` — eacp::Video — Decoder.h:26
  - `Accurate` = 0 — Land exactly on the requested time: decode from the preceding keyframe and discard up to it.
  - `Keyframe` = 1 — Land on the nearest keyframe at or before the time — much cheaper, and enough while a scrub bar is still moving.
